SELECT i.intervention_id, i.intervention_name, i.region_id, AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date < i.start_date::date THEN dr.critical_cases ELSE NULL END) AS baseline_critical_cases, AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date >= i.start_date::date AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR dr.date::date <= i.end_date::date) THEN dr.critical_cases ELSE NULL END) AS post_intervention_critical_cases, AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date < i.start_date::date THEN dr.deaths ELSE NULL END) AS baseline_deaths, AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date >= i.start_date::date AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR dr.date::date <= i.end_date::date) THEN dr.deaths ELSE NULL END) AS post_intervention_deaths, (AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date < i.start_date::date THEN dr.critical_cases ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date >= i.start_date::date AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR dr.date::date <= i.end_date::date) THEN dr.critical_cases ELSE NULL END)) AS reduction_in_critical_cases, (AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date < i.start_date::date THEN dr.deaths ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN dr.date::date >= i.start_date::date AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR dr.date::date <= i.end_date::date) THEN dr.deaths ELSE NULL END)) AS reduction_in_deaths FROM interventions i LEFT JOIN daily_reports dr ON i.region_id = dr.region_id GROUP BY i.intervention_id, i.intervention_name, i.region_id ORDER BY i.intervention_id, i.region_id;

SELECT s.suburb_name, (COALESCE(e.median_weekly_income, 0) + COALESCE(e.average_household_income, 0) + COALESCE(ss.life_satisfaction_score, 0) + COALESCE(ss.sentiment_score, 0) + COALESCE(ss.healthcare_quality_score, 0) - COALESCE(ss.crime_rate, 0) + COALESCE(ds.population, 0) - COALESCE(ds.unemployment_rate, 0) - COALESCE(ds.homeless_rate, 0) + COALESCE(ds.nonreligious_percentage, 0) + COALESCE(ds.citizenship_percentage, 0)) AS overall_score FROM suburbs s LEFT JOIN economic_statistics e ON s.suburb_code = e.suburb_code LEFT JOIN social_statistics ss ON s.suburb_code = ss.suburb_code LEFT JOIN demographic_statistics ds ON s.suburb_code = ds.suburb_code ORDER BY overall_score DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.artist_name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.release_id) AS total_releases, MAX(r.release_year) AS most_recent_release_year, COUNT(t.track_id) AS total_tracks, AVG(CAST(t.track_length AS NUMERIC)) AS average_track_length FROM artists a LEFT JOIN releases_artists ra ON a.artist_id = ra.artist_id LEFT JOIN releases r ON ra.release_id = r.release_id LEFT JOIN tracks t ON r.release_id = t.release_id GROUP BY a.artist_id, a.artist_name ORDER BY a.artist_name ASC

WITH RankedDowntime AS (SELECT m.machine_no, ml.problem_type, ml.duration_per_event, ml.start_down, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ml.machine_id) AS issue_count, AVG(ml.duration_per_event) OVER (PARTITION BY ml.machine_id) AS avg_downtime_per_issue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ml.machine_id ORDER BY ml.duration_per_event DESC) AS rn FROM maintenance_logs ml JOIN machines m ON ml.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(ml.start_down, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) = 2022) SELECT machine_no, problem_type, duration_per_event AS total_downtime, issue_count, avg_downtime_per_issue FROM RankedDowntime WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY duration_per_event DESC;

WITH carrier_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        a.airport_id,
        a.name AS airport_name,
        c.carrier_id,
        c.name AS carrier_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.cancelled), 0) AS total_cancellations,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.delayed), 0) AS total_delays,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.cancelled + fs.delayed), 0) AS overall_performance,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.total), 0) AS total_flights,
        COALESCE(AVG(CAST(fs.average_delay_minutes AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS avg_delay_minutes
    FROM airports a
    LEFT JOIN flight_statistics fs ON a.airport_id = fs.airport_id
    LEFT JOIN carriers c ON fs.airport_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name, c.carrier_id, c.name
    HAVING COALESCE(SUM(fs.total), 0) > 0
),
ranked_carriers AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_id,
        airport_name,
        carrier_id,
        carrier_name,
        total_flights,
        total_cancellations,
        total_delays,
        avg_delay_minutes,
        overall_performance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY airport_id ORDER BY overall_performance DESC) AS performance_rank
    FROM carrier_performance
)
SELECT 
    airport_name,
    carrier_name,
    total_flights,
    total_cancellations,
    total_delays,
    avg_delay_minutes
FROM ranked_carriers
WHERE performance_rank <= 3
ORDER BY airport_name, performance_rank;

SELECT t.text AS tweet_text, t.created_at, a.sentiment, a.impressions, a.engagement_rate, a.engagement_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT h.hashtag_text, ', ' ORDER BY h.hashtag_text) AS hashtags_used, (a.impressions * a.engagement_rate / 100) AS total_engagements, a.engagement_rate AS engagement_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.engagement_rate DESC) AS engagement_rank FROM tweets t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id JOIN analytics a ON t.tweet_id = a.tweet_id LEFT JOIN tweet_hashtags th ON t.tweet_id = th.tweet_id LEFT JOIN hashtags h ON th.hashtag_id = h.hashtag_id WHERE u.screen_name = 'exampleUser' GROUP BY t.tweet_id, t.text, t.created_at, a.sentiment, a.impressions, a.engagement_rate, a.engagement_value ORDER BY t.created_at DESC;

SELECT c.cache_name, c.cache_type, c.max_size AS max_memory_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric = 'max_hit_ratio' THEN m.value::numeric END) AS max_hit_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT u.app_id) AS num_applications, SUM(u.hits) AS total_hits, SUM(u.misses) AS total_misses, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.parameter = 'max_time_to_idle_seconds' THEN cc.value::numeric END) AS max_time_to_idle_seconds FROM caches c LEFT JOIN cache_usage u ON c.cache_id = u.cache_id LEFT JOIN cache_monitoring m ON c.cache_id = m.cache_id AND m.metric = 'max_hit_ratio' LEFT JOIN cache_configurations cc ON c.cache_id = cc.cache_id AND cc.parameter = 'max_time_to_idle_seconds' WHERE c.read_only = 1 AND c.max_size > 500000 AND c.eviction_policy = 'LRU' AND c.time_to_live_seconds > 600 GROUP BY c.cache_id, c.cache_name, c.cache_type, c.max_size ORDER BY total_hits DESC

WITH RECURSIVE region_paths AS (
    SELECT region_id, region_name, region_name::TEXT AS full_path
    FROM geographic_regions
    WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT gr.region_id, gr.region_name, rp.full_path || ' > ' || gr.region_name
    FROM geographic_regions gr
    INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON gr.parent_region_id = rp.region_id
),
access_counts AS (
    SELECT d.dataset_id, d.dataset_name, d.description, d.source, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
    FROM datasets d
    INNER JOIN access_logs al ON d.dataset_id = al.data_id
    GROUP BY d.dataset_id, d.dataset_name, d.description, d.source
    HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) >= 1
),
cumulative_counts AS (
    SELECT dataset_id, SUM(access_count) OVER (ORDER BY dataset_id) AS cumulative_access_count
    FROM access_counts
)
SELECT rp.full_path AS region_full_path, ac.dataset_name, ac.description, ac.source, ac.access_count, cc.cumulative_access_count
FROM region_paths rp
INNER JOIN region_dataset rd ON rp.region_id = rd.region_id
INNER JOIN access_counts ac ON rd.dataset_id = ac.dataset_id
INNER JOIN cumulative_counts cc ON ac.dataset_id = cc.dataset_id
ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(access_date::TIMESTAMP) FROM access_logs al WHERE al.data_id = ac.dataset_id) DESC NULLS LAST, ac.access_count DESC;

SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(ec.datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    SUM(ec.load) AS total_load,
    AVG(ec.load) AS average_load,
    MAX(ec.load) AS max_load,
    MIN(ec.load) AS min_load,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(ec.load) < 1000 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN SUM(ec.load) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS load_category
FROM energy_consumption ec
JOIN regions r ON ec.nuts2_code = r.nuts2_code
JOIN processes p ON ec.process_id = p.process_id
JOIN years y ON ec.year_id = y.year_id
WHERE r.region_name = 'Slovakia - Bratislava'
    AND p.process_name = 'heating_residential'
    AND ec.source_type = 'residential'
    AND ec.subprocess = 'heating_living_room'
    AND ec.energy_source = 'electricity'
    AND y.year = 2010
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(ec.datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(ec.load) < 1000 THEN 1
        WHEN SUM(ec.load) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;

)

        region_id,
        region_name,
        parent_region_id,
        region_name::TEXT AS hierarchy_path
    FROM geographic_regions
    WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        gr.region_id,
        gr.region_name,
        gr.parent_region_id,
        rh.hierarchy_path || ' > ' || gr.region_name
    FROM geographic_regions gr
    INNER JOIN region_hierarchy rh ON gr.parent_region_id = rh.region_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE employee_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        e.employee_id,
        e.employee_name,
        CAST(e.years_at_company AS NUMERIC) AS years_at_company,
        e.performance_rating,
        1 AS level,
        e.employee_name::TEXT AS name_path,
        l.location_name,
        l.city,
        l.state,
        l.country,
        e.department,
        r.rating_balance,
        e.performance_rating AS cumulative_performance
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.location_id
    LEFT JOIN ratings r ON e.employee_id = r.review_id
    WHERE e.manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.employee_id,
        e.employee_name,
        CAST(e.years_at_company AS NUMERIC) AS years_at_company,
        e.performance_rating,
        eh.level + 1 AS level,
        eh.name_path || ' -> ' || e.employee_name AS name_path,
        l.location_name,
        l.city,
        l.state,
        l.country,
        e.department,
        r.rating_balance,
        eh.cumulative_performance + e.performance_rating AS cumulative_performance
    FROM employees e
    INNER JOIN employee_hierarchy eh ON e.manager_id = eh.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.location_id
    LEFT JOIN ratings r ON e.employee_id = r.review_id
)
SELECT 
    employee_id,
    employee_name,
    years_at_company,
    performance_rating,
    level,
    name_path,
    location_name,
    city,
    state,
    country,
    department,
    rating_balance,
    cumulative_performance
FROM employee_hierarchy

        selected_editions,
        regexp_split_to_table(selected_editions, ',')::bigint AS edition_id
    FROM comparisons
),
most_compared_edition AS (
    SELECT 
        edition_id,
        COUNT(*) AS comparison_count
    FROM split_comparisons
    GROUP BY edition_id
    ORDER BY comparison_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

    SELECT 
        mce.edition_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ef.feature_id) AS feature_count
    FROM most_compared_edition mce
    JOIN edition_features ef ON mce.edition_id = ef.edition_id
    WHERE ef.is_available = 1
    GROUP BY mce.edition_id
),
feature_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        ef.feature_id,
        COUNT(*) AS usage_count
    FROM most_compared_edition mce
    JOIN edition_features ef ON mce.edition_id = ef.edition_id
    JOIN split_comparisons sc ON mce.edition_id = sc.edition_id
    WHERE ef.is_available = 1
    GROUP BY ef.feature_id
)

    e.edition_name,
    efc.feature_count,
    COALESCE(AVG(fu.usage_count), 0) AS avg_feature_usage
FROM most_compared_edition mce
JOIN editions e ON mce.edition_id = e.edition_id
JOIN edition_features_count efc ON mce.edition_id = efc.edition_id
LEFT JOIN feature_usage fu ON 1=1
GROUP BY e.edition_name, efc.feature_count;

WITH goal_differences AS (
    SELECT 
        m.competition_id,
        m.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        c.competition_name,
        SUM(
            CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.full_time_score, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) - 
            CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.full_time_score, '-', 2) AS INTEGER)
        ) AS actual_goal_diff,
        SUM(p.predicted_goals_scored - p.predicted_goals_conceded) AS predicted_goal_diff
    FROM matches m
    JOIN predictions p ON m.match_id = p.match_id
    JOIN teams t ON m.team_id = t.team_id
    JOIN competitions c ON m.competition_id = c.competition_id
    WHERE m.full_time_score IS NOT NULL 
        AND p.predicted_goals_scored IS NOT NULL 
        AND p.predicted_goals_conceded IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.competition_id, m.team_id, t.team_name, c.competition_name
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        competition_name,
        team_name,
        (actual_goal_diff - predicted_goal_diff) AS goal_diff_difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY competition_id 
            ORDER BY (actual_goal_diff - predicted_goal_diff) DESC
        ) AS rank_num
    FROM goal_differences
)

FROM ranked_teams

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        category_id,
        category_name,
        parent_category,
        category_level,
        category_name::TEXT AS full_path
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_category IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        c.parent_category,
        c.category_level,
        ct.full_path || ' > ' || c.category_name AS full_path
    FROM categories c
    INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_category = ct.category_name
)
SELECT 
    s.store_name,
    sp.first_name,
    sp.last_name,
    ct.full_path,
    SUM(sd.sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount
FROM category_tree ct
LEFT JOIN sales_data sd ON ct.category_name = sd.category1
LEFT JOIN stores s ON sd.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN salespeople sp ON sd.salesperson_id = sp.salesperson_id
GROUP BY s.store_name, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, ct.full_path
ORDER BY s.store_name, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, ct.full_path;

WITH yearly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(e.enrollment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.course_review_id) AS reviews
    FROM enrollments e
    LEFT JOIN course_reviews cr ON e.student_id = cr.student_id
    WHERE e.enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND e.enrollment_date != ''
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(e.enrollment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
),
ratio_data AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        CASE 
            WHEN enrollments > 0 THEN reviews::DECIMAL / enrollments 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS ratio
    FROM yearly_data
)
SELECT 
    year,
    ratio,
    AVG(ratio) OVER (
        ORDER BY year 
        ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_6yr
FROM ratio_data
ORDER BY year;
